metadata.name: Neon Pulse
metadata.description: A heavy slanted word lit in electric blue neon, pulsing every two seconds with a glow that ripples out from the centre to the ends. Move the pointer to move where the ripple starts, click to send an extra pulse.
metadata.author: louisstudios
